key_issues: No main landmark (<main>) for primary content (WCAG 1.3.1, 2.4.1).
No clear bypass mechanism like a skip link to jump to main content (WCAG 2.4.1).
fix_strategy: Wrap the primary content in a single <main id="main"> landmark.
Add a keyboard-accessible skip link that becomes visible on focus and targets #main.

changes.what_changed: Added a meaningful <title> element to the document head.
Wrapped the page’s primary content in a single <main> landmark with id="main".
Added a 'Skip to main content' link that is visually hidden until focused, pointing to #main.
